text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Friday, November 9, 2018 Posted by admin on November 9th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include McDonald’s (MCD), Merck (MRK), UnitedHealth (UNH) and Walgreens (WBA). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -124 points.
Thursday the Dow was up +10.92 (+0.04%) at 26,191.22.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.95%.
There were 22 Dow stocks up Thursday.
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by 3M (MMM) +1.38%, Cisco (CSCO) +1.13% and American Express (AXP) +1.11%.
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by Exxon Mobil (XOM) -1.59%, Chevron (CVX) -1.25% and Disney (DIS) -0.90%.
Walt Disney (DIS -0.90%) rose 2% in after-hours trading after it reported Q4 adjusted EPS of $1.48, higher than consensus of $1.34.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down 1.2 cents at $2.723 per gallon.
